summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend test of Feature A (User Management) and Feature B (Contact Enquiries) for FOXY Properties. 17/17 pytest backend cases pass; all critical UI flows verified via Playwright including public enquiry submit, admin login + sidebar, enquiries status change (persisted after reload, badge updates), user CRUD with duplicate guard, agent-only sidebar + redirects for restricted routes, own-row deactivate hidden, and Turkish toggle translating labels (Ad Soyad, Mesaj, E-posta, Talep Türü).

issues: Cookie banner (data-testid=cookie-banner) is a full-screen overlay (fixed inset-0 z-[80]) that intercepts all pointer events until Accept is pressed – fine functionally but blocks any automation/user interaction with the form until dismissed. Consider making it bottom-anchored (not inset-0) so the form remains interactable.

critical_code_review_comments: src/app/api/backoffice/users/route.ts POST returns only {ok,id} – consider returning the full created user row for easier front-end state updates (currently UI must refetch list).
Enquiry POST schema uses snake_case (full_name, enquiry_type) while most REST payloads elsewhere could clash – ensure docs/clients are consistent; not a bug.
`last-admin` and self-deactivation/self-demotion guards both return 400 with distinct messages – good. Confirmed working end-to-end.
src/app/api/enquiries/route.ts fires notify + confirmation emails in Promise.allSettled and logs failures – good, DB write is not blocked by email outage.
